lesson.child_mission: Writing an explanation with a diagram means the caption and labels match the written causes; the visual should not contradict the text.
lesson.evidence_instructions: Save the independent response, specific revisions and both short-answer explanations; record oral evidence for speaking tasks.
lesson.extension: Apply the same strategy to an unfamiliar topic or audience, then compare the effect of two different choices.
lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Fix a mismatch: text says condensation forms clouds, but the diagram arrow skips from evaporation to rain with no cloud label.

FEEDBACK
Add a condensation/cloud stage label so the diagram matches the written causes.

CHECK
Decorating a page with an unrelated clip-art image does not support the explanation.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Write a 150–180 word explanation with an integrated diagram (sketch allowed). Include three labels, a caption and two causal connectives in the text.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
lesson.learning_intention: Writing an explanation with a diagram means the caption and labels match the written causes; the visual should not contradict the text.
lesson.offline_alternative: Use paper and pencil to complete the original task, then retain a photograph or short parent observation as evidence.
lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Write a 150–180 word explanation with an integrated diagram (sketch allowed). Include three labels, a caption and two causal connectives in the text. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Sample: original example using explanation on new material; names a specific word, source or choice and explains its effect.

Parent: Written model 2: Sample error: Decorating a page with an unrelated clip-art image does not support the explanation.. Correction: Add a condensation/cloud stage label so the diagram matches the written causes.. Why it helps the audience is stated.

Parent: Likely misconception: Decorating a page with an unrelated clip-art image does not support the explanation. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Produce a fresh example demonstrating explanation on new material (not the worked model). Explain the particular words, sources or choices that make it work.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Name one likely error with explanation, correct it, and explain why the correction helps a reader or audience.

Parent: Marking notes: Accept original work about explanation with a specific supporting detail. Reject copied model wording with no new material. / Accept a misconception, a correction, and a purpose-linked reason for explanation. Reject corrections that do not change the inaccurate idea..

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Text: lower sun → longer shadow. Diagram: sun drawn low with a long shadow arrow labelled. Caption: "Afternoon sun position stretches the shadow."

TRY FIRST
Fix a mismatch: text says condensation forms clouds, but the diagram arrow skips from evaporation to rain with no cloud label.

FEEDBACK
Add a condensation/cloud stage label so the diagram matches the written causes.
teach_steps.explain:
Writing an explanation with a diagram means the caption and labels match the written causes; the visual should not contradict the text.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner make decisions based on specific language evidence, rather than guess or copy someone else. Keep the meaning accurate and explain the choice.

HOW TO WORK
Read the original example and locate the words or actions that support the idea. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Check your response against the feedback: did you address the same skill and show your reasoning? If a detail is uncertain, identify what would have to be checked. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than making the answer longer.
teach_steps.notice: Decorating a page with an unrelated clip-art image does not support the explanation. Correct the meaning, not just the appearance.
